analyst.summary: Raymond Lifestyle is the branded-apparel business (Raymond, Park Avenue, ColorPlus, and related brands) spun out as part of the wider Raymond Group's three-way demerger completed in 2025. Revenue is growing at a healthy double-digit pace, but profitability remains thin and volatile -- the company swung to a loss in the most recent quarter after a profitable prior quarter -- and the stock's current valuation already prices in a level of earnings stability the business has not consistently shown yet.
